description.zh-CN: 超轻量的开源个人 Agent（HKUDS）：浏览器 WebUI、终端 TUI、聊天渠道三种方式干活，会读写文件、记偏好、跑定时任务；Python 实现，配置与聊天记录都存在你自己电脑的 ~/.nanobot。
description.en: Ultra-lightweight open-source personal agent (HKUDS): works from a browser WebUI, a terminal TUI or chat channels — reads and writes files, remembers preferences, runs scheduled tasks; pure Python, config and history stay in ~/.nanobot on your machine.

runtime.note: Python 3.11+ required (docs: "You need Python 3.11 or newer"). No system Node needed for daily use. Install target is a dedicated virtualenv at ~/.nanobot/venv — user-directory only, zero admin, mirrors the official installer's layout.

args: $v="$env:USERPROFILE\.nanobot\venv"; if (!(Test-Path $v)) { py -3 -m venv $v }; & "$v\Scripts\python" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip; & "$v\Scripts\python" -m pip install -q "$env:USERPROFILE\.aibox\cache\downloads\nanobot_ai-0.4.1-py3-none-win_amd64.whl"
install.notes: Mirrors the official installer's layout: dedicated virtualenv at ~/.nanobot/venv, installed from the hash-verified release wheel — no admin, no system pip (avoids PEP 668 issues). Prerequisite: Python 3.11+ (`py -3`) installed manually first; if absent, use the official one-liner route from the guide. Dependencies resolve from PyPI (pip); on CN networks a pip mirror can be set manually. TODO real-machine verification.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.notes: Configure in WebUI Settings → Models (writes ~/.nanobot/config.json, docs/configuration.md). Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works via the custom provider.

anthropic.label: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.notes: nanobot reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or stores the preset in ~/.nanobot/config.json (docs reference ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for deployments).

ollama.label: Local Ollama models (free, offline, no key)

recommendedModels.name: Qwen2.5 7B
recommendedModels.note: Good Chinese output, runs on 8 GB RAM

ollama.notes: Docs ship a dedicated Ollama provider recipe (docs/providers.md#ollama) plus any OpenAI-compatible local server (vLLM etc.).

upgrade.notes: Check = local probe vs the upstream latest tag the daily probe records; upgrade = re-run the same install flow (pip installs the newer wheel into the same venv), matching the project's "upgrade through your original installation method" rule — stop the gateway first and back up ~/.nanobot.

steps: Stop the gateway (`gateway stop` or Ctrl+C in the launcher terminal)
Delete the install + data directory ~/.nanobot (venv, config.json, session history)
Optional: clear the pip download cache if you need the disk space
uninstall.notes: Everything the product owns lives under ~/.nanobot; only generic pip caches can remain outside it.

risk.onUninstall: ~/.nanobot 里有你的模型 Key（config.json）、聊天记录（SQLite 会话历史）和工作区数据，删除后全部丢失——请先备份 / Your API keys (config.json), chat history (SQLite sessions) and workspace data live in ~/.nanobot — deleting it removes them all; back up first.
